description: This file is a PHP script that serves as a launcher for test results and metrics in the TestLink open source test management project. It initializes the page, loads configurations, performs permission checks, and generates a report navigation GUI for test plans and test results.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns the arguments object with request parameters, session data, and default values.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object including page URL, test plan IDs, and accessible test plans, based on user permissions and session data.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has the rights to access test plan metrics.
